title: The Nutcracker 2026
seo_title: The Nutcracker 2026 at Landers Theatre, Springfield MO
description: The Nutcracker 2026 is a presentation of the holiday ballet classic by Springfield Ballet, celebrating the company's 50th anniversary. Performances run December 17-21, 2026, with a run time of two hours including a 20-minute intermission. This listing is for December 19, 2026 (Time TBD) at the Historic Landers Theatre, 311 E Walnut St in Springfield, MO.
